text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer learns to identify what is shown in a picture, such as a cat or a plane. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects within an image. These technologies have many useful applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognise traffic lights, road signs, and pedestrians. This helps the car make safe decisions while driving. Computer vision is also used in medicine, security, and shopping. As technology improves, it will become even more important in the future.
